title: Developer Feedback
tagline: Developer feedback on the Avail & Arbitrum Orbit integration docs
description: Here is my developer feedback on the Avail & Arbitrum Orbit integration docs. Highlighted navigation challenges, missing prerequisites, and areas for clarity to help improve the developer experience. Planned to build a Rollup chain with Arbitrum Orbit & Avail DA at a hackathon. Despite deploying contracts successfully, I hit blockers with Docker configs. Saving this idea for next time & sharing feedback with Avail to improve the process.
how_its_made: The project aimed to integrate Avail, a modular data availability layer, with Arbitrum Orbit, a framework for custom Layer 3 Rollup chains on Ethereum. I navigated through Docker, Foundry, and SubWallet to set up the environment, deployed Rollup contracts, and tested configurations. Focused on improving the docs for a smoother developer experience.
